parsed_json.up: Select approved drugs with max_phase = 4 that have non-null EFO indication identifiers and labels. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Join compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN to require canonical SMILES. Return DISTINCT rows for chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie (EFO identifier), indication_label (EFO term), and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
